title: 移动端长任务的热状态感知进度与 ETA
summary: 移动设备长时间高负载时吞吐可能显著变化，因此 ETA 应基于滚动实测吞吐而不是初始 FPS 线性外推；热状态是解释性能变化的运行证据，不应被误报为编码器故障。
invariants: ETA uses rolling observed throughput rather than assuming initial speed remains constant.
Thermal status is surfaced when the platform exposes it.
Parallelism defaults are bounded and measured rather than derived mechanically from logical core count.
Thermal throttling changes performance expectations but does not by itself imply output failure.
